description: $0.01 USDC on Solana — $0.01 buys one reference check of one submitted citation reference (PMID, DOI, or arXiv). The payment buys the full signed field-by-field report: the verdict, per-field comparison, and the register record relied on. Submitted reference content is processed in memory only and never stored; the paid retry re-sends the reference. This service verifies that a submitted citation reference resolves in its register and whether the claimed fields match the register's record. It does not judge whether the cited work supports any claim made about it, and it does not grade the cited work.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the caller; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

reference.description: The submitted citation reference: { type?, id, claimed: { title, authors?, year? } }. type is optional (inferred from the id form: PMID, DOI, or arXiv). Submitted content is processed in memory only and never stored.
